paid_execution_requirements.budget_journal: single-machine locked crash-conservative journal outside the fresh run directory
paid_execution_requirements.credential_transport: private 0600 auth file to anonymous one-shot inherited file descriptor; neither credential nor its fingerprint enters artifacts
paid_execution_requirements.filesystem_isolation: re-observe the macOS Seatbelt production profile and bound negative probes before provider access
paid_execution_requirements.governed_recall: the model-visible KgRecall schema requires lexical_plan; the Zig executor retains query-only compatibility for legacy non-model callers
paid_execution_requirements.local_tinykg: the TinyKG treatment uses a fresh isolated local store; no benchmark arm uses the remote harness
paid_execution_requirements.offline_memory_immutability: before credential exposure, Seatbelt probe v3 must prove every offline Markdown and TinyKG root immutable while allowing only the transient <store>/.tinykg-cli.lock subtree
paid_execution_requirements.query_plan_reporting: explicit model plans and host-scoped recall are separately reported; host recall only covers an absent duplicate call and cannot launder malformed explicit plans
paid_execution_requirements.remote_tinykg: forbidden for benchmark corpus, trace, and store; refined verification only
paid_execution_requirements.semantic_grader: JSON is compared structurally and Python registries are checked with AST literal assignment equality without executing candidate code; v14 remains frozen under its original grader
paid_execution_requirements.tinykg_read_preflight: before budget reservation, the exact pinned TinyKG binary must run store-info and one bounded lexical search inside the production Seatbelt profile, release its CLI lock, and preserve raw and normalized store digests
paid_execution_requirements.tool_result_semantics: only successful memory write results count as mutations; rejected attempts remain visible as tool errors and immutable tree digests remain mandatory
paid_execution_requirements.toolchain_snapshot: ripgrep is copied to the canonical run-owned 0500 snapshot before provider access; rollout copies derive from that snapshot

arms.treatment: external memory, host recall, consolidation, and TinyKG retrieval disabled
host-observed online execution episode consolidated to durable Markdown, then exposed read-only offline
host-observed episode imported into isolated TinyKG, derived lexical catalog published, automatic scoped recall performed, and model retrieval forced through a replayable lexical query plan
